row.evidence: Mailchimp's Enterprise SSO guide says "Enterprise SSO is available to Premium accounts" (OIDC only) and "An Owner or Admin must invite the user's email address ... before they can access Mailchimp"; no SCIM or user-provisioning API is documented.
row.notes: Status changed from partial (June) to none. The June row rested on the third-party "Mailchimp Provisioning Connector by Aquera" in the Okta catalogue, which is built and maintained by Aquera, not Mailchimp. Mailchimp itself documents no SCIM endpoint, no JIT (SSO users must first be invited by an Owner or Admin), and its Marketing API has no account-user resources; Okta's own Mailchimp app is SWA (password vaulting) only. SSO is OIDC-only, IdP-initiated only, and Premium-only. Pricing is by contact count and billed monthly; annual plans only for Premium and Standard at 10,000+ contacts via sales. Seats: Free 1, Essentials 3, Standard 5, Premium unlimited. Under the post-pilot rules the Aquera connector is recorded as idp.okta third_party and does not change status; scim.available is null rather than false because no Mailchimp page says SCIM is not offered. Mailchimp's sitemaps list no SCIM page.

limitations.text: Even with Enterprise SSO, users are not created on sign-in: an Owner or Admin must invite each email address first.
The only provisioning connector in the Okta catalogue is a third-party product built and maintained by Aquera, not Mailchimp.

The Marketing API reference lists no account-user, team or role resources; its resources cover audiences, campaigns, automations, reports, templates, e-commerce and similar marketing objects. 'available: false' is read from that complete resource list, not from an explicit statement.

okta.notes: Okta lists two Mailchimp apps: Okta's own Mailchimp app (okta.com/integrations/mailchimp/) has only SWA checked in its page markup, and the 'Mailchimp Provisioning Connector by Aquera' is built and maintained by Aquera, not Mailchimp. This entry records the Aquera connector; its OIN page does not say how it talks to Mailchimp, so kind is null. Mailchimp's own Okta guide uses a custom OIDC app.

open_questions: No Mailchimp page says in so many words that SCIM is not offered; 'none' rests on the SSO guide (manual invites, no JIT), the absence of any SCIM or user-provisioning docs, and an API reference with no account-user resources.
Whether Mailchimp offers SCIM or provisioning on custom / high-volume contracts is not public.

The Okta catalogue lists a Mailchimp app with SWA only; Mailchimp's own guides use a custom OIDC app in Okta and an app registration in Entra. No Entra gallery tutorial was found (Learn URLs for a Mailchimp tutorial returned 404).
Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue pages for Mailchimp were not verified (JumpCloud returned Access Denied).

The static pricing page shows $13 / $20 / $350 at the default contact tier with a 'for 12 months' discount label; it is not clear whether these are list or promotional prices, or which contact tier Premium's $350 applies to.
Whether Mailchimp has an audit log (UI or API) and whether account users can be bulk-imported by CSV is not documented in the pages checked.
